title: Knobby French Chicken Casserole
description: A tangy and adventurous French dish from the Alsace region featuring coconut cream and beurre-monte, perfect for those who dislike onion and garlic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the beurre-monte over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, lemon juice, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked chicken and mushrooms to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the bread cubes in the bottom of the dish.
Pour the chicken and mushroom mixture over the bread cubes.
Top with the remaining bread cubes.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
